name: Ayane
source:
A neat and sheltered housewife.
She was born to a local celebrity and was raised without any inconveniences, so she is kind, selfless, and has an innocent side that makes it easy to trust others.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1278057
